changelog: Adding a device on an account that has none works. The app creates that account's first power station itself, and it was creating it with no address, no city and no location at all — at latitude 0, longitude 0 — which the server refuses, so the device that would have gone into it was refused too. The station now gets a real place, derived from the phone's own time zone, and can be corrected afterwards.
The device is then added the same way it is for an account that already has a station — the path that has always worked.
If it still fails, the failure screen has a Try every variant button that sends each remaining candidate in turn and reports which one the server accepts, along with the account's own roles.
